provenance: Fresh adversarial correspondence review on 2026-11-01. Read the immutable bundle unit, required exact Rust/test selections, review policy, and listed supporting context. Independently traced error and boundary cases; did not reuse earlier positive conclusions. Rust best-practice skill and v2/AGENTS.md were consulted.
rationale: Definition selection dispatches to def, abbrev, structure, and inductive forms and retains their complete selected bodies, while definition_source preserves citation order. Its top-level body detection distinguishes binder defaults from := bodies and supports the documented indented equation/where forms. Tests cover complete equation arms, structure literals, multiline abbrevs, literal/comment decoys, missing bodies, ambiguous names, wrong kinds, and nested commands. Grammar selection deliberately has the narrower unqualified type-declaration contract and same-line abbrev header requirement. The mutual-inductive fixture and rejection tests cover the separate supported group boundary. Authored mathematics is not inferred from any declaration body.
limitations: This is a source and test-body correspondence review. It does not claim that the reviewed test suite, Lean compiler, browser, or configured command profiles were executed by this reviewer. Named context inputs were consulted for the relevant helpers, fixture declarations, or presentation rules; unrelated declarations in conservative file snapshots are not asserted to have been fully reviewed.
